annotations.title: Generate a download link for a report of an exam

description: Generate a download link for a report of an exam. The link is not authenticated, it can only be used once and expires in an hour. Only the examinees visible for the current user are included. Needs reporting permission for the exam.

filters.description: only include the examinees matching the given user data, the same way as with edubase_post_exam_results_export (filterable reports only)

format.description: one of the formats of the report (default: the first)

language.description: language of the report (default: the language of the user)

round.description: number of the round, mandatory for results-round only

name: edubase_post_exam_report
